tagline: Six hit points, played as a dial — R2 tunes his own health into card values

featuredCards.title: It Deserves Our graditute
featuredCards.caption: Sets his health to any number you like. Every other card in the deck reads that number, so this is the tuning knob.

featuredCards.title: Holographic Message
featuredCards.caption: Worth exactly what R2 is worth. Topped up, it is one of the biggest numbers in the game.

featuredCards.title: Not just a droid
featuredCards.caption: The inverse: it pays out most when he is nearly gone. Low health is a loaded weapon here, not a crisis.

featuredCards.title: You're my only hope
featuredCards.caption: The safety net that makes those one-health turns survivable. He simply refuses to fall over.
